title: Send a message
summary: Erlang: Send a message. Send a different score.
introduction: A process has a mailbox. ! sends a message, and receive reads a matching message.

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.

blocks.title: Send a message
blocks.code:
-module(lesson).
-export([main/0]).
main() ->
    self() ! {score, 8},
    receive {score, N} -> io:format("~p~n", [N]) end.

blocks.text: self() names this process. The tuple is sent to its mailbox, then receive extracts 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: receive waits if no message matches; real waiting code often needs after.
